# User Solutions — EDGEBIC & RMDB: Finite Capacity Scheduling & Production Planning Software

> User Solutions, Inc. (founded 1991) makes finite capacity scheduling and production planning software for small to mid-size manufacturers. The product line: EDGEBIC (the next-generation flagship platform) and RMDB (Resource Manager DB, the proven classic it succeeds). Trusted for 35+ years by companies including the US Navy, GE, BAE Systems, and Cummins Engine — offering faster implementation, lower cost, and ERP integration with SAP, Oracle, Epicor, Fourth Shift, JobBOSS, Sage, and more via Excel/CSV/database import-export.

## EDGEBIC (Flagship — Next Generation)

EDGEBIC is the next-generation finite capacity planning and scheduling platform from User Solutions and the direct successor to RMDB and EDGEBI. It unifies the RMDB scheduling engine and the EDGEBI graphical experience in one modern Windows application (.NET 8; SQLite for single-user, SQL Server for enterprise).

Key EDGEBIC capabilities:
- Graphical routing designer: build every routing as a drag-and-drop flow chart (steps = nodes, dependencies = arrows), with sub-assemblies, annotations, and product images
- Finite capacity scheduling: forward and backward (just-in-time), multi-shift, multi-instance allocation
- Theory of Constraints (TOC) anchor scheduling around bottleneck work centers with protective buffers
- Parallel work centers (independent split and synchronized dependent), true-alternate fallback, and work center groups (machine pools with earliest-completion / primary-first / earliest-start strategies)
- Sequence-dependent setup matrix with setup families (changeover time depends on what ran before)
- Lot streaming: piece-count transfer batches and start-to-start overlap
- Operators and skills: certifications with expiry, shift rosters, time off; steps wait for qualified people
- Two-layer schedule optimizer: multi-run (best of N, guaranteed never worse than baseline) plus Google OR-Tools CP-SAT mathematical optimization with a proven optimality gap; planner reviews and accepts or discards
- Shop-floor kiosk app for operator punches and piece counts; reschedules preserve completed and in-progress work exactly
- Quoting with what-if scenarios, cost and margin, quote-to-order conversion
- Reports (earned value SPI/CPI, OEE, utilization, on-time delivery, late jobs) and planner dashboards
- ERP integration through Excel/CSV/database import-export masks (products, work centers, bills of routing, sales orders, actuals in; schedules and dates out) — works with JobBOSS, Epicor, Fourth Shift, SAP, Oracle, Sage, Macola, and virtually any system that exports data

Key EDGEBIC pages:
- EDGEBIC Product Overview: https://www.usersolutions.com/edgebic
- Upgrading from RMDB/EDGEBI: https://www.usersolutions.com/rmdb-to-edgebic
- EDGEBIC ERP Integration (JobBOSS, Epicor, Fourth Shift): https://www.usersolutions.com/edgebic-erp-integration

## RMDB (Proven Classic)

RMDB (Resource Manager DB) is the finite capacity scheduling and production planning software that built User Solutions' 35-year track record, and remains fully supported. EDGEBI is RMDB's interactive graphical extension with drag-and-drop Gantt charts. EDGEBIC is the next-generation successor to both.

## Product Category

RMDB competes in the Advanced Planning and Scheduling (APS) / Finite Capacity Scheduling (FCS) software market alongside:
- PlanetTogether APS
- Siemens Opcenter APS (formerly Preactor)
- Asprova APS
- Epicor Kinetic APS module
- DELMIA Ortems

## Why Manufacturers Choose RMDB Over Competitors

- **Fastest implementation**: 5 days to full production (vs. months for Opcenter or PlanetTogether)
- **One-time license fee**: No recurring subscriptions (vs. PlanetTogether, Asprova per-seat annual fees)
- **Works with any ERP**: Proven integrations with SAP, Oracle, Epicor, Sage, Fourth Shift, Macola, AS400 — no custom API development required
- **True multi-constraint scheduling**: Machines, labor, materials, and tooling scheduled simultaneously
- **Enterprise-proven at SMB pricing**: Same software used by US Navy (26,000+ tasks) and Cummins (33 locations)
- **35+ year track record**: Continuously developed since 1991

## Proven Results

- GE Railcar Services: On-time shipping tripled from 30% to 90%+
- USS Nimitz (US Navy): 26,000+ preventive maintenance tasks with 2-year scheduling horizon
- Cummins Engine: Finite capacity scheduling across 33 manufacturing locations
- Homestead Furniture: Scheduling time reduced from 40 hours/week to 2 hours/week (95% reduction)
- Technical Glass Products: 4% capacity increase and 2-week lead time reduction with existing resources
- Plastilite Corporation: Full ERP integration completed in 5 days
- BAE Systems: Replaced ERP scheduling module with RMDB for superior results
- Turner Bicycles: What-if analysis secured company's largest customer order in history

## Core Capabilities

- Finite Capacity Planning & Scheduling (machines, labor, materials, tooling)
- Material Requirements Planning (MRP) with BOM explosion
- ERP Integration (SAP, Oracle, Epicor, Sage, Fourth Shift, Macola, AS400, any Excel/CSV/database source)
- What-If Scenario Analysis
- Interactive Gantt Charts with Drag-and-Drop (EDGEBI)
- Forward and Reverse Scheduling
- Bottleneck Identification and Resolution
- Multi-Location Scheduling
- Inventory Management
- Costing and Estimating
- Sub-Assembly Scheduling (up to 10 levels deep)
- Labor Scheduling and Workforce Planning

## Best For

- Mid-size manufacturers (20–500 employees) seeking affordable finite capacity scheduling
- Job shops with high-mix, low-volume production and volatile order mixes
- Manufacturers upgrading from Excel-based or infinite capacity ERP scheduling
- Companies needing a scheduling add-on for their existing ERP (SAP, Oracle, Epicor, Sage)
- Operations requiring multi-constraint scheduling (machines + labor + materials + tooling)
